name: TESSERA PG-2 'Signature'
description:
A single-shot .22 caliber firearm disguised as a premium writing instrument. The Signature is 14 centimeters long, weighs 45 grams, and is visually indistinguishable from the TESSERA-branded executive pens distributed to thousands of corporate employees. The firing mechanism is activated by removing the pen cap and pressing the pocket clip forward — a gesture that looks identical to preparing to write. The weapon fires a single .22 round from the pen barrel with enough velocity to be lethal at contact range.

TESSERA does not officially manufacture the Signature. The company's position is that the PG-2 was a proof-of-concept prototype that was never approved for production. This explanation is complicated by the fact that functional PG-2 units appear consistently on the black market with genuine TESSERA manufacturing stamps, serial numbers that match TESSERA's proprietary format, and build quality that no counterfeit operation could replicate. Someone at TESSERA is producing these weapons. The company's legal department maintains plausible deniability.

The Signature's lethality is limited — a single .22 round from a 14-centimeter barrel has minimal stopping power — but its purpose is not battlefield effectiveness. It exists for the moment when a corporate executive sits across the table from someone who needs to die, and needs to die right now, in a room where weapons were supposedly impossible to bring.
specifications:
caliber: .22 LR
capacity: 1 round
effective range: 3 meters (contact weapon)
barrel length: 90mm
weight: 45g
length: 140mm
form factor: Indistinguishable from TESSERA executive pen
tactical_use: Close-range assassination in environments where weapons screening has been passed. The Signature is a weapon of last resort or premeditated close-quarters killing. Users must be within arm's reach of their target and accept that they will have one shot with no follow-up capability.
cultural_context: The Signature has achieved near-mythical status in GLMZ's corporate culture. Every TESSERA pen is now regarded with slight suspicion, and security-conscious executives have been known to refuse writing instruments offered by others. The weapon has poisoned the most basic gesture of professional courtesy.
known_users: High-value targets who carry one for personal protection
story_hooks: A corporate executive was killed in a secure boardroom by a Signature round during a negotiation. Every person in the room was screened. Every person in the room is carrying a TESSERA pen. The weapon has not been found because it is hiding in plain sight among a dozen identical pens.

A batch of PG-2 units has been intercepted with modified ammunition — the .22 round replaced with a chemical injector that delivers a delayed-action toxin. The pen doesn't even need to be fired. It just needs to scratch the target.

physical_description.visual_profile: An elegantly tapered writing instrument with a polished metallic barrel that tapers to a fine point. At first glance, completely indistinguishable from a high-end executive pen — the kind distributed in corporate gift sets. The cap is seamlessly integrated, the pocket clip is functional and stylized, the overall presentation screams luxury branded merchandise. Only the subtle weight distribution and the precision machining of the barrel interior would reveal its true purpose to someone who knows what to look for.
physical_description.dimensions: 140mm (5.5 inches) overall length; 90mm (3.5 inches) barrel; diameter approximately 8mm at thickest point, tapering to 6mm at the tip
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively heavy for its size — 45 grams creates a substantial, premium feel in the hand. The weight is front-loaded toward the barrel, giving the impression of a quality ballpoint with a tungsten or steel nib. This heft is intentional: it mimics the tactile expectation of a luxury writing instrument.
physical_description.primary_material: Precision-machined steel barrel wrapped in aerospace-grade aluminum alloy body. Internal firing mechanism utilizes reinforced polymer housing to contain pressure during discharge.
physical_description.finish: Mirror-polished satin steel with matte anodized aluminum accents. The barrel gleams under office lighting, while the grip section features a subtle brushed finish to prevent slipping during the 'writing preparation' gesture.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal silver and charcoal black. The TESSERA branding is rendered in discrete champagne gold lettering along the grip section.
physical_description.grip_texture: Smooth anodized aluminum with microscopic grip patterns imperceptible to casual touch — designed to feel like premium brushed metal. The pocket clip is knurled for authentic pen-like handling.
distinctive_features: Integrated retractable pocket clip styled as standard executive pen hardware
Cap removal mechanism that is simultaneously the trigger activation sequence
Subtle TESSERA branding in gold leaf along the grip — authentic corporate pen aesthetic
Precisely drilled nib opening disguising the .22 caliber barrel tip
Internal breech mechanism visible only under magnification
Serial number stamp matching TESSERA's proprietary format on the clip base
Subsonic chambering allows for minimal report — dry, muffled crack at contact range
No visible safety — firing sequence relies entirely on the cap removal + clip press gesture
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA REHABILITATION MEDICINE and 'SIGNATURE SERIES' etched in 2mm gold lettering on the barrel, starting 3cm from the grip. Serial number stamped on the inside of the pocket clip. Manufacturing date coded into the clip's knurling pattern — invisible to inspection but traceable to TESSERA's internal production records.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. These weapons are manufactured to exacting standards and typically appear new, even when recovered from crime scenes. A well-maintained Signature shows no wear — it's designed to survive exactly one use and then be discarded or retained as a trophy. Field-used examples may show micro-scratches on the barrel or slight discoloration of the anodized sections, but structural integrity remains absolute.

image_prompt: Product photography of a luxury executive pen lying on a dark reflective surface, shot at a 45-degree angle with dramatic side-lighting casting sharp shadows. The pen gleams with satin metallic finishes in gunmetal and charcoal. TESSERA branding visible in subtle gold lettering. Shot in clinical corporate product-photo style, but with moody neo-noir lighting that emphasizes the precision machining and subtle menace of the design. A gloved hand (tactical black leather with silver accents) positioned near the pocket clip as if reaching for it, fingers millimeters from the trigger activation gesture. High depth of field, shallow background blur, emphasizing the pen's premium craftsmanship. Cinematic rim lighting along the barrel edges. Cold color temperature, 2226 aesthetic. --ar 3:2 --v 6
